name: dsh-xingkong-theme
description: Nebula Core: a deep-space observatory theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — same-direction cross-dissolve wallpaper loops (never a reversing ping-pong) behind a fully clear, un-veiled conversation pane, white-ink-on-photograph typography with soft blurred shadows (never a glyph outline), Montserrat + Noto Sans SC on a real variable-weight axis, and a 74-token light/dark palette. v1.13 adds a built-in model probe service: see which configured models actually answer, plus their real context window.
author: 石岩
